sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]So send I you—by grace made [Db7/Ab]strong to [Gm]triumph
[F]My name to bear, and in that name to con quer—
[F/C]“As the Father [C7]hath sent Me, Sosend [F]I you”

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]So send I you- to take to [Db7/Ab]souls in [Gm]bondage
[F]To break the bonds [Bb]of sin, to [Gm]loose dearth's [F/C]fetters-
[F/C]So send I you, [C7]to bring the [F]lost to Me.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]So send I you- My strength to [Db7/Ab]know in [Gm]weakness,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]So send I you- to bear My [Db7/Ab]cross with [Gm]patience,
[F]To hear My voice, 'Well done, My faithful servant-
[F/C]'As the Father [C7]hath sent Me, so [F]send I you.'
